### Lessons in Defeat
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-january-13.html
Passage: 1 Kings 22:48
Points:
- God in His sovereign wisdom may prosper one person while frustrating another's plans in the same endeavor.
- Believers should thank God during seasons of loss and setback just as readily as during times of worldly success.
- Even those who are deeply cherished by the Lord can endure painful disappointments and wrecked plans.
- Jehoshaphat suffered defeat because he allied himself with a sinful household contrary to God's will.
- Christians should heed the warning against being unequally yoked with unbelievers in worldly partnerships.
